NIA Arrests Khalistan Supporter Surinder Singh at Delhi Airport

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) arrested Surinder Singh, a supporter of the Khalistan Zindabad Force, upon his arrival at Delhi Airport. Singh was deported from the United States to India. Reports indicate he was allegedly involved in a plot to blow up railway tracks.
